witnesses.required_invariant: Different contrast targets are different complete propositions; order cannot choose the sole surviving target.

witnesses.title: String-different rewrites reuse one patient fact
witnesses.required_invariant: Storage normalization and evidence-family identity must distinguish a rewrite from new independent evidence.

witnesses.title: Conflicting root n read from first surviving member
witnesses.required_invariant: The root owns one validated connective/count; inconsistent repeated root slots are rejected.

witnesses.title: One observation supplies two near-duplicate criterion votes
witnesses.required_invariant: Count criterion identities and valid witnesses, not retained assertion rows; same fact can serve two only with explicit distinct-criterion proof.

witnesses.title: Group effects disappear: exclusion gains points, necessary OR never vetoes
witnesses.required_invariant: Apply one root-level effect to the complete expression truth for ALL, ANY and count groups alike.

witnesses.required_invariant: Eligibility applies before every root action and score; one clinical member cannot license treatment members as diagnostic necessity.

witnesses.title: F9 noncriterion guard is absent from group path
witnesses.required_invariant: A declared inert row remains inert in group and contrast paths, not only atomic L3.

witnesses.required_invariant: Candidate labels are not unique identity; validate duplicates or normalize registry before calculating candidate-set weights.

witnesses.title: Negated, differential, numerically false contrast still penalizes comparator
witnesses.required_invariant: Contrast requires signed truth, source direction, scope, stage and target proof; co-mention and raw present are insufficient.

witnesses.title: One satisfied grouped atom bypasses incomplete root in L4
witnesses.required_invariant: Do not execute grouped contrast leaves independently of the full root condition.
